answer: Gate entry with a live skill exam, not a fable of self-declared credentials: each new identity is a vertex in a proctored test where three rotating examiners pose a fresh task it must solve within one epoch. Passing earns one exam credit; failing or cheating forfeits a 25,000 POA fee and bans the identity ten epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus 1,000 proctored exams to fake, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once and keeps its credit like a banked ember. Weakness: examiners can collude or grade harshly, so honest beginners may fail a fair exam.
